verdict.rationale: Flagsmith is a feature-flag management platform, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other MCP servers' tools falls outside its product category. The documented Flagsmith MCP Server is the server role: it exposes Flagsmith to external agents. That belongs to a separate story and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
